messages.subject: Shiny server install problem
parts:
Hi.  I've installed Ubuntu server 12.10 on a VirtualBox.  I then followed the install instructions here;
https://github.com/rstudio/shiny-server/wiki/Ubuntu-step-by-step-install-instructions

The command line runs through the instructions then asks:
After this operation, 78.5MB of disk space will be used.  Do you want to continue [Y/n]?
I've tried Y, y, yes and just pressing enter.  Each time it returns: Abort.
Any ideas why?

Thank you!

messages.author: 3b077512ac9cfefc
messages.subject: Re: Shiny server install problem
parts:
On Thursday, 4 April 2013 15:41:50 UTC+1, Iain Dobson wrote:
RESOLVED!  **How do I set this thread to complete?**

I was trying to copy the whole set of instructions from the step-by-step list.  That was lazy!
Run each line individually.  The last line of the # Install Node.js instructions, the line line: sudo apt-get install nodejs npm
failed.  So I used the Ubuntu instructions on this page: https://github.com/joyent/node/wiki/Installing-Node.js-via-package-manager
I then returned to https://github.com/rstudio/shiny-server/wiki/Ubuntu-step-by-step-install-instructions
and completed the remaining commands.

Worked a charm.

Iain.
